title: My Lunchbox
description: Three short recordings about lunchboxes: sharing food, a small green box and a note from mum.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · What is in your lunchbox?
parts.intro: You will hear Linh and Nam.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: What's in your lunchbox, Nam?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: I have a cheese sandwich and an apple.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: I have rice and chicken.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Do you have a drink?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Yes, I have water. Do you have juice?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: No, I have milk.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Your apple looks nice, Nam. Can I have a small piece?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Yes, of course. Do you want some of my sandwich too?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: No, thank you. I have enough food. Let's play after lunch.

parts.title: Part 2 · A small green box
parts.intro: You will hear Mr Tan and Mai.

script.speaker: Mr Tan
script.text: Mai, where is your lunchbox?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: It's in my bag, Mr Tan.

script.speaker: Mr Tan
script.text: Is it big?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: No, it's small and green.

script.speaker: Mr Tan
script.text: What is inside?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: A banana, some bread and a cake.

script.speaker: Mr Tan
script.text: That sounds like a good lunch. Please eat it slowly, Mai.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yes, Mr Tan. I'm hungry, and I love cake.

script.speaker: Mr Tan
script.text: Enjoy your lunch, Mai. Then wash your hands.

parts.title: Part 3 · Mum's message
parts.intro: You will hear a mum talking to her son Ben.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Ben, I made your lunch. Look in the box.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: There are two sandwiches, some grapes and a biscuit.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Please eat the grapes first. Don't forget your water bottle. Have a nice day!

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: I like to make your lunch, Ben. Be good at school today.
